text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her debut race approaches. Extraordinary 
expectations and all manner of ambitions 
rest upon the youngest scion of the 
'Illustrious Clan'...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Daiichi Ruby remains steadfast. 
While she appreciates the expectations 
placed upon her, she states she never 
feels burdened by them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill her family's duty, Daiichi Ruby 
heads into the race, shouldering every 
single expectation on her own—
